data.name: Lailummeen
data.gender_notes: Lailummeen is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Lailummeen is derived from 'Lail' meaning night and 'Ummeen' meaning Lord or Master. It signifies the Lord or Master of the night. The name Lailummeen carries the meaning “Night's Lord” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Lailummeen usually hope their child will grow to embody night's lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the Quran, the term 'Lailummeen' or similar concepts are associated with Allah being the Master of all times, including the night.
data.etymology: Lailummeen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Night's Lord.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lailummeen total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: لَيْلُمّين
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مؤنث من الأسماء النادرة، مشتق من لَيْلٌ وَمِينٌ، ويعني الليل والنهار جميعاً، الوقت كله، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة القدر: «وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ * لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ»

in_urdu.name: لَیلُمّین
in_urdu.long_meaning: یہ نام لیل ومين سے ماخوذ ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے رات اور دن، پورا وقت، وقت کی مجموعی اصطلاح، اسلامی تقویم میں اس کا اہمیت ہے کیونکہ یہ لیلۂ قدر کے معنی سے جڑا ہوا ہے

in_hindi.name: लैलुम्मीन
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह नाम लैला और मीन से बना है, जिसका अर्थ है रात और दिन, समय की पूरी अवधि, इस्लामी परंपरा में इस नाम का विशेष महत्व है, खासकर लैलۂ قدر के संदर्भ में

in_english.name: Lailummeen
in_english.meaning: Night and day, all the time
in_english.long_meaning: This name is derived from Arabic roots 'Layl' and 'Meen', signifying night and day, encompassing the entirety of time, holds significance in Islamic tradition, particularly referenced in the Quranic description of Lailat al-Qadr

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, Lailummeen is celebrated as a night of special significance during the Holy month of Ramadan. It is the night when Muslims believe that Allah [God] started revealing the Quran to Prophet Muhammad through the angel Jibreel. This belief is celebrated with great devotion as 'Lailatul Qadr' or the Night of Power. Muslims believe that reciting the Quran on this night brings immense blessings and rewards.
data.spiritual_significance: Lailummeen holds a deep spiritual significance in Islam. It is the night when Muslims believe that Allah's presence descends upon the earth, and the Angels and the spirits are close to Allah's creation. Muslims are encouraged to seek forgiveness from Allah, ask for His blessings, and make duas [prayers]. The night is often spent in prayer, supplication, and reflection on the teachings of the Quran. Lailummeen is a reminder of the day of Judgement and the importance of seeking Allah's mercy and forgiveness.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Night's Lord" symbolizes Lailummeen is derived from 'Lail' meaning night and 'Ummeen' meaning Lord or Master. It signifies the Lord or Master of the night.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Lailummeen serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of night's lord.

historical_references.reference: Lailummeen is mentioned in the Hadith of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) as the name of a companion who was known for his generosity and hospitality.
